coordinates.object_orientation: Spire apex +Z; main aperture toward -Y, broad body whorl offset -X and aperture toward +X in front view to match dextral shell orientation. Center bounding box in X/Y, rest bottom at Z=0. Do not mirror reference chirality.

concept.reason: Named Pliocene specimen is available in three photographic orientations plus an additional same-species two-view plate. These directly establish shell morphology and scale; a generated concept adds no necessary evidence.

scope: Original low-poly interpretation of the shell exterior and visible aperture of PRI 69688, not an exact scan or living-animal reconstruction. UF 247451 is corroborating species morphology only, not the source of this specimen scale.

scale.basis: PRI69688 three-view photograph: its 5 mm vertical bar is about 39 px; shell image height roughly 220 px gives approximately 28 mm. Width/depth are working estimates from oblique views, not caliper measurements.
scale.uncertainty: Approximate visual scale; allow about 15% proportional interpretation. No specimen-exact biometric claim. Do not use the distinct 4 cm UF247451 scale or PRI70745 3.5 cm as PRI69688 measurements.

required_features: Strongly inflated smooth rounded final body whorl; it dominates most shell volume.
Low but clearly raised dextral spire with a few progressively smaller whorls and visible sutures; not a tall tower.
Large genuinely open semicircular/oval aperture facing front (-Y), curved outer lip, straighter columellar side; aperture occupies most shell height.
Thick columellar callus forms a small shoulder over the dark umbilical recess beside the aperture; keep recess distinct from the large main opening.
Aperture interior is a continuous shallow shell lining, not a painted black disk, a fully filled sphere, or a detached white ring.
Preserve convex back and asymmetric shell volume; do not mirror into two equal valves.
simplifications: Fine growth lines may be omitted; gentle broad low-poly facets are enough.
Natural staining, chips, museum writing and exact taphonomic imperfections are not required.
Do not reconstruct soft body, operculum, deep internal coils, siphonal canal, or biological colors.
Use restrained warm fossil-ivory/stone palette; this is artistic, not inferred living coloration.
acceptance_focus: Front image clearly shows the real opening and columellar/umbilical recess, not only a spherical outline.
Side and top retain inflated body and low asymmetric spire.
Compare all four standard views to the three photographic views before final export.
GLB and blend/source output match; original source and declared relative dependency closure, Khronos/geometry and two cheap isolated rebuilds remain required.
maker_notes: Read private/PRI69688 reference and research.md before building; original geometry only, no downloaded museum mesh.
The image license is non-commercial share-alike; photos stay in private research and must not enter model texture/public delivery. Public references contain links and factual attribution only.
